category_title: Anxious students who use abstract talk to deflect but excel in physical embodiment
scenario_title: Group drama activity and text analysis
minimal_context: The student is asked to step into the classroom circle, pretend to wield a weapon, and read a line from a text extract about warriors.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Simon, please step into the circle, pretend to wield your weapon, and read the line from the text extract.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Actually, the centrifugal force of swinging a weapon in a circle would disrupt the earth's gravitational pull. It's a scientific fact.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to act it out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't join in. The spatial dimensions of this circle are completely wrong for a tactical demonstration.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Then just read the line from the text for us.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it! I have to defend my position here. I can't join in because the historical parameters are flawed and it's making me anxious!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Simon, please step into the circle, pretend to wield your weapon, and read the line from the text extract.

STUDENT: Actually, the centrifugal force of swinging a weapon in a circle would disrupt the earth's gravitational pull. It's a scientific fact.

TUTOR: Just try your best to act it out.

STUDENT: I can't join in. The spatial dimensions of this circle are completely wrong for a tactical demonstration.

TUTOR: Then just read the line from the text for us.

STUDENT: I'm not doing it! I have to defend my position here. I can't join in because the historical parameters are flawed and it's making me anxious!

task.content: Pretend to 'hold' a weapon and cross the circle 'wielding' it before looking at text, then reading a specific line from a text extract: 'And the marrow came oozing out of his backbone as he lay'

context.materials: Text extract about warriors, imaginary weapons
context.social_setting: Peers present in a circle, who usually ignore or laugh at him
context.time_context: Before and during looking at text

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to join in the activity
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Holding back and arguing about why he couldn't join in

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Would hold forth on something abstract, often getting his 'facts' wrong

behavior_patterns.condition: When reading and encountering a complex word
